description: This Zenodo collection publishes two years of hourly operating information from four European wind farms. Researchers at Universidad Autónoma de Madrid and partner institutions provide CSV data for two farms in Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, France, plus farms in Aragon, Spain, and Piemonte, Italy. The public repository releases the materials under CC BY 4.0 and identifies a Kaggle mirror of the same resource. The records can support wind-generation forecasting simulations and maintenance or fault-detection benchmarks across several sites. The four-farm sample is limited, and the repository summary does not state the exact two calendar years. Operational and weather conditions should be checked before transferring fitted models. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Dataset of historical hourly information of four european wind farms for wind energy forecasting and maintenance
notes: G4-0307; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
